research_question: Which mechanisms from current comparable agent frameworks, persistent-memory systems and cognitive architectures can improve Frank v0.1 without replacing its owner-fixed ClayCode-only causal semantic architecture, and which apparent similarities should be rejected?

steps: boot current Clay and Frank repository truth
survey comparable projects by architectural class
inspect representative implementation source, not only README/marketing
derive mechanism-level gaps and superior external mechanisms
fuse only mechanisms compatible with current Frank invariants
perform a second external search for counterevidence and newer memory/GWT/control results
convert supported discoveries into architecture candidates and falsifiable test obligations
method.important_limit: External repositories were inspected through current GitHub/web source surfaces. Their code was not executed locally in this run, so all external comparisons are SOURCE_LEVEL evidence until matched executable benchmarks are built.

key_properties: one persistent self.root with Frank as human surface
one central authoritative UnifiedDB and derived ClayGraph
single active cognitive presence lease with monotonic lease_epoch fencing
runtime cycle already models workspace broadcast, receiver closure, verified outcomes, causal credit, admitted learning, provenance-bound re-entry and loop-regime readout
Hyperposition preserves materially different unresolved alternatives
Harness mutation authority remains external to self.root

deep_code_inspection.frank_gap_or_delta: Frank has richer causal semantics but should borrow explicit durability-policy and checkpoint/write-order conformance tests.
Use as a simplicity baseline: every Frank loop-core mechanism must justify itself against a minimal tool/handoff loop under matched budgets.
Add a resume compatibility fingerprint over semantic topology/schema/binary/config, but allow explicit validated migrations rather than strict hash equality.
Add typed ContextBudgetReadout and versioned projections; reject prompt-memory as semantic authority because Frank authority stays in UnifiedDB/ClayCode.

strong_mechanisms: movable active HEAD and preserved branches
deep_code_inspection.frank_gap_or_delta: Strong implementation model for Hyperposition as a semantic branch DAG plus active leaf, and for explicit stuck discriminators. Never persist hidden chain-of-thought.
Add a low-overhead CognitiveCycleShadow with phase-level latency/state-change/activation/resource counters to make loop-regime claims experimentally discriminable.
Use observer-style incremental projection as a test candidate for UnifiedDB -> ClayGraph updates; do not create a second semantic authority.
High-value candidate: explicit bitemporal/temporal fact validity in UnifiedDB while raw episode provenance remains immutable.
Keep transport/runtime services separable from self semantics; service boundaries must not become new cognitive identities.
Add a transport replay sequence distinct from lease_epoch so authority fencing and client delivery/replay are never conflated.

comparative_survey.coverage_note: This is a broad representative architecture census, not a mathematically exhaustive list of every public agent repository. Projects were grouped by unique mechanism; near-duplicate orchestration frameworks were not given equal depth when they added no new mechanism.

second_search_counterevidence.finding: GNW-like integration/ignition is not itself proof of broadcasting; directed information-flow signatures are required to distinguish broadcasting from generic integration.
second_search_counterevidence.impact: Supports Frank's receiver-use/outcome/re-entry receipts and rejects a single emergence or ignition scalar as architecture truth.

second_search_counterevidence.finding: Long-term agent-memory research in 2026 reports major gains from structured, conflict-aware and temporally indexed memory, while high-accuracy coding-agent retrieval can carry high latency.
second_search_counterevidence.impact: Supports cheap multi-stage candidate retrieval before expensive cognition, with conflict detection and temporal validity on the write/admission path.

second_search_counterevidence.finding: SQLite WAL permits concurrent readers but ordinarily only one writer at a time.
second_search_counterevidence.impact: Current one-global-cognitive-lease design makes SQLite plausible for v0.1, but background telemetry/indexing/research/effect ingress still requires a measured write-contention lane and bounded transaction durations.

second_search_counterevidence.finding: Current LangGraph issue evidence shows that serializer/type mismatch can silently degrade checkpoint state if compatibility is not fail-closed.
second_search_counterevidence.impact: Strengthens the resume-compatibility fingerprint and typed-state migration tests; a checkpoint existing is not sufficient evidence of faithful recovery.

second_search_counterevidence.finding: Active-inference work formalizes epistemic information value but also exposes exploration/exploitation sensitivity and potential over-exploration.
second_search_counterevidence.impact: If used, epistemic value belongs only in bounded opportunity ranking under Frank's existing initiative budget; it must never become truth, reward, or effect authority.

fusion_model.name: FRANK_CAUSAL_SEMANTIC_KERNEL_WITH_DURABLE_PROJECTION_FABRICS
fusion_model.core_claim: Frank should not converge toward a generic agent framework. Its differentiator should remain a compact causal semantic kernel whose admitted state changes require provenance and whose learning path closes through verified outcome -> causal credit -> admitted delta -> provenance-bound re-entry. Orchestration, retrieval, graph projection, checkpointing and stream delivery should remain replaceable measured fabrics around that kernel.
retain_from_frank: GWT receiver closure and causal-use distinctions
candidate_transplants: Graphiti-style temporal validity + episode provenance fields
OpenHands-style semantic branch DAG/active leaf for Hyperposition
MAF-style topology/config resume fingerprint with migration compatibility relation
Mastra-style indexed transport replay sequence separate from cognitive lease epoch
Letta-style explicit context-budget accounting without prompt-memory authority
LangGraph-style durability policy and checkpoint write-order tests
OpenHands-style stuck discriminator and resume compatibility checks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding explicit temporal fact validity and immutable source-episode lineage to UnifiedDB will improve contradiction handling, temporal reasoning and stale-fact abstention without needing to make ClayGraph authoritative.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Existing epoch/provenance structures already encode enough temporal information; new validity fields only duplicate state and increase write/update complexity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched LongMemEval-style temporal/update tasks plus contradiction injection: compare existing schema against temporal-validity candidate on accuracy, abstention, stale-fact errors, write latency and state amplification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Representing Hyperposition alternatives as a semantic event/branch DAG with an active leaf will reduce snapshot duplication and improve reversible alternative exploration while preserving ancestry.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Branch DAG bookkeeping adds complexity and biases cognition toward historical branches; current set-valued Hyperposition is simpler and sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Replay identical alternative-rich tasks with set-valued baseline vs branch-DAG candidate; measure storage amplification, recovery, branch switch latency, task success, false branch revival and semantic-equivalence errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A ResumeCompatibilityFingerprint over binary/build, ClayCode semantic version, UnifiedDB schema epoch, loop topology and parameter vector will prevent silent state corruption across restarts/upgrades.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Strict fingerprints create needless incompatibility and block safe rolling migrations.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fault-inject old/new schema and topology combinations; compare strict rejection, explicit migration relation and current behavior on silent corruption, false rejects, recovery time and replay equivalence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating presence lease_epoch from a monotonic API/event stream sequence will improve reconnect/replay/idempotency semantics without weakening single-presence authority fencing.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A second monotonic clock is redundant because existing presence event seq and effect/request IDs can cover replay.
hypotheses.falsifier: Disconnect/reconnect, duplicated delivery, stale client and lease takeover matrix; measure missing/duplicate chunks, stale-effect attempts and recovery latency with one-clock vs dual-clock designs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A low-overhead CognitiveCycleShadow containing per-phase latency, candidate counts, receiver closure, memory/context cost, state delta and re-entry depth will materially improve loop-regime classification and configuration search.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Instrumentation perturbs timing and creates observability/state amplification without improving decisions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Enable/disable shadow on matched seeds and tasks; require useful regime-classification or tuning gain greater than CPU/RAM/latency/storage perturbation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid temporal+semantic+keyword+graph candidate retrieval can reduce expensive context assembly while improving recall, provided retrieval evidence never directly admits semantic truth.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Fusing correlated retrieval channels produces false confidence and more distractors; a simpler typed query path is more accurate and cheaper.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched memory/OOD suite with independent channel ablations; measure recall@k, precision@k, nDCG, temporal correctness, contradiction rate, downstream task success, latency and token cost.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A first-class typed ContextBudgetReadout will improve token/latency efficiency by making context sources and compression decisions measurable per cycle.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Provider-specific token accounting leaks physical implementation details into cognitive semantics and causes brittle optimization.
hypotheses.falsifier: Keep ContextBudgetReadout as non-authoritative resource shadow; compare adaptive vs fixed assembly across model/provider backends for outcome quality, token cost and transfer robustness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Because Frank permits only one active cognitive presence, SQLite single-writer semantics are likely sufficient for v0.1 if all auxiliary write paths are short, queued or serialized; a server DB migration is not justified without measured contention.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Telemetry, indexing, effects, API state and proactive/research ingress will create enough independent writers that SQLite becomes a reliability/latency bottleneck before v0.1 acceptance.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-VPS mixed workload with cognitive lease activity plus telemetry/effect/index/background ingress; measure p50/p95/p99 write wait, SQLITE_BUSY, queue depth, checkpoint interference and recovery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded epistemic information value can improve proactive opportunity ranking when uncertainty is reducible, but only as a small non-authoritative term beneath current user-task and effect constraints.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Even bounded epistemic value creates curiosity loops and unnecessary exploration that reduce task closure.
hypotheses.falsifier: Lesion/add epistemic term under identical opportunity sets; measure verified useful outcomes per cost, task interruption, unnecessary exploration, unresolved-pressure reduction and recovery.

new_integrated_hypothesis_after_counters.statement: The strongest near-term architecture is not a larger monolithic agent loop but a smaller causal semantic kernel surrounded by explicitly versioned and replaceable fabrics: (1) temporal/provenance memory admission, (2) branchable alternative-state projection, (3) durable checkpoint/resume compatibility, (4) separate transport replay sequencing, (5) hybrid candidate retrieval, and (6) low-overhead cycle/resource shadows. Every fabric must be lesionable and must beat a simpler baseline under outcome, recovery and resource metrics.
new_integrated_hypothesis_after_counters.strongest_counterhypothesis: This decomposition merely renames conventional workflow/database components and increases boundaries; the simplest successful Frank could be a LangGraph/MAF-style durable workflow plus memory and effect gates, with no special causal semantic kernel.
new_integrated_hypothesis_after_counters.decisive_experiment: Build a matched Minimal Durable Agent baseline using existing mature orchestration semantics and compare it against the current Frank causal-kernel candidate on the same identity, memory-update, tool-effect, restart, temporal-conflict and long-horizon tasks. Hold model, prompts/semantic inputs, tool access and budgets constant. Promote Frank-specific machinery only where it provides statistically and operationally meaningful benefit.

architecture_delta_candidates.change: Add explicit effective validity interval/reference-time/source-episode semantics for mutable world/self facts, preserving immutable observation/provenance history.
Test semantic alternative branches as parent-linked receipts with active leaf and abandoned-branch preservation; never persist hidden chain-of-thought.
Bind restart/resume to binary/build/schema/semantic/topology/config identity and explicit validated migration compatibility.
Keep authority fencing lease_epoch separate from delivery/replay stream sequence and idempotency identities.
Add lesionable per-phase dynamics/resource shadow for loop-regime classification and configuration search.
Use multi-channel retrieval only for candidate generation; require normal semantic admission and provenance before any truth/state mutation.

rejected_or_not_promoted: Do not replace Frank with LangGraph, MAF, ADK, Letta, OpenHands, Mastra or another general agent framework on source-level comparison alone.
Do not make ClayGraph or retrieval rank semantic truth.
Do not interpret GWT ignition/integration as consciousness or as proof of causal broadcasting.
Do not persist hidden chain-of-thought in branch/event structures; persist only typed semantic alternatives, evidence, decisions and receipts.
Do not copy self-editing prompt memory into Frank's authority plane; memory projections remain derived/model-facing views of admitted state.
Do not replace SQLite solely because server databases offer more concurrency; first measure target-VPS contention under the current single-presence contract.
Do not use epistemic curiosity as reward, truth or authority.
